title: Replace mock-only frontend with typed FastAPI integration and selective Tamagui
objective: Integrate caregiver and patient experiences with the verified FastAPI contract, preserve platform safety boundaries, then add targeted Tamagui primitives and complete cross-platform verification.
acceptance_criteria: FastAPI/OpenAPI contracts and gaps are verified before client implementation
Caregiver and patient credentials remain strictly separated
Screens consume typed feature view models rather than direct fetch calls
Production-like builds never silently fall back to mock data
Caregiver and patient flows have loading, stale, offline, retry, and failed-write behavior appropriate to their roles
Only Tamagui is introduced as a UI library and only after a passing integration slice
Existing navigation, glass architecture, identifiers, accessibility, and dignity constraints remain intact
Frontend, backend, contract, integration, browser, and available native-device gates pass
Independent Reviewer approves before BOSS acceptance

result.summary: Typed FastAPI clients, React Query, RHF/Zod caregiver setup and settings, device-token patient game writes, selective Tamagui inputs, contract checks, and backend response typing are complete and reviewed.
limitations: Live browser caregiver save requires a non-production Supabase session and seeded local backend fixture; neither is configured in this workspace.
No authorized Android or iOS device/simulator is attached for physical validation.
